changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 5 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/5926-empty-action-visible-when.md`

- names `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` → `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `visibleWhen` is not a per-block concern in this platform. It is enforced **once, generically**, in `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx`: `shouldHide` tests `visibleWhen` ahead of the hoisted `visible` (objectui#5454), sets `_hidden`, and the `_hidden` early return fires **before** the registry dispatches. A block renderer cannot ignore the gate, because it never sees the node.

### `.changeset/7319-dead-schemarenderer-retired.md`

- names `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` → `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `packages/components/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` was a 28-line component carrying the same export name as the real renderer in `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx`. Nothing reached it: it is absent from the package barrel, no file in the repo imports it by any form, and the package's `exports` map has no subpath that resolves to it.

### `.changeset/7415-action-type-input-rename.md`

- names `SchemaRenderer.tsx` → `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` — edited by this change

  > **Census of the authored corpus, measured before the rename, not assumed.** Across 4,797 files in `examples/`, `apps/console/`, `content/docs/` and `packages/`: **zero** authored nodes set the input. 517 JSON files (433 of them the schema catalog) contain 2,410 `type`-bearing nodes and **no** `action:button` / `action:icon` node at all — control: 127 plain `button` nodes on the same walk. 207 parsed fenced JSON blocks in md/mdx carry **5** `action:button` nodes, all of them `{ type, label, icon?, action }` — the discriminator plus the `action` channel, none setting an execution type — control: 28 plain `button` nodes, and the count independently matches the corpus census already recorded in `SchemaRenderer.tsx` ("`action:button` (5 nodes)"). No docs page documents the input; no catalog entry uses the components. So the rename breaks no authored document in this repo.

### `.changeset/8284-content-channel-per-component.md`

- names `content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md` → `content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md` — edited by this change

  > **Migration.** Nothing that renders today stops rendering: a document authoring the channel its renderer reads is unchanged, and a document authoring the other one rendered an empty element before and is now refused instead. The repo-wide census found five documents in this state — `packages/react/README.md`, `content/docs/guide/expressions.md`, two blocks in `content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md` and `packages/components/TESTING.md` — every one of them a `form` or `container` authoring `body`; all five are corrected in this change. If your own metadata authors the refused channel on one of these twelve node types, the component was already drawing nothing there; rename the key to the one in the table.

### `.changeset/9308-data-root-unbound-from-adapter.md`

- names `content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md` → `content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md` — edited by this change

  > The Data Context passages of `content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md` and `packages/react/README.md` teach the scope channel accordingly.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `c255b3838` (merge-base with origin/main): 2 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1202 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (1760 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/35417945018)

**ACCEPT — objectui#9746 · PR objectui#9991 · head `6ce4ab1199`**

Reviewed-by: `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`

Readings below were taken by **this seat**, ⛔ not copied from the dev report.

## ⭐⭐ The finding that matters most — the dev refused to write a sentence the card licensed

The dispatch carried a **stop-and-hand-back** for the case where the re-take showed the render path no longer behaving as letter B describes. It did not fire, and correctly so: the render path still skips the zod root parse and a production build still validates nothing. **But one sub-reading of the card DID move**, and the dev reported it instead of papering over it.

The card's refinement said the one shape the render path rejects — a record-form retired key — is rejected **for an unrelated reason** (`schema.children.type: type is required`), so even that coverage is accidental and never names the retirement. At head that no longer reproduces: objectui#6771 retired the second child-list spelling **inside the walker**, so the walker no longer descends the key and the record shape is now simply **accepted** like the other four.

⭐ The right move was available and taken: the new prose makes only the **general measured statement** and ⛔ does **not** assert the accidental coverage. Verified on the added lines — `children.type` **0**, `type is required` **0**, `accidental` **0**; lit control `validation door` reads **2**, so the instrument is reading the added prose and the zeros are real.

⚠️ That is precisely the sentence class PR objectui#9360 was FAILED for: a docblock asserting behaviour the code does not have. A dev that wrote the card's refinement verbatim would have shipped a false sentence into published docs on the strength of a reading that had rotted.

⇒ `Clause-②: no` — nothing published moves. `content/` is in no published `files[]`, the changeset releases no package, and the only source file touched is byte-identical once comments are stripped.

## Two dev notes, answered

1. **`Clause-②: no` is written as a markdown heading (`## Clause-②: no`), not a bare line.** ⭐ The dev flagged it rather than silently PATCHing, and separately measured that **no objectui gate parses that line** (`Clause-②` appears only in a comment in `scripts/check-handler-key-read-sites.mjs`). This seat confirms the consequence: the carrier checker lives in the **sibling** repo's toolchain, and this card is `Clause-②: no`, so ⛔ **no carrier is owed and none is hung**. ⇒ nothing to repair, and ⛔ ⛔ this seat will **not** PATCH the body: a body PATCH appends a footer unconditionally and would trade a cosmetic fix for a duplicated attribution block.
2. **Two exports both named `validateSchema`** (the `@object-ui/core` structural walker and the `@object-ui/types/zod` parse). Correctly **not filed** — a naming collision with no reproducible defect, no declared-contract breach and no metadata trap is in the do-not-file set. ⭐ The new section naming both **by package** is the cheap mitigation, and it is already in the diff.

## The `changeset-claim-re-read` gate (comment `5738910666`) — answered

5 pending bodies name a file this change touches. Re-read against the diff: **this change falsifies none of them.** The one that could have — `.changeset/8284-content-channel-per-component.md`, which claims 「two blocks in `content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md` … all five are corrected in this change」 — describes blocks authoring a **refused content channel**; this diff adds a prose section and introduces no such block, so the count it asserts is untouched.
